fact: Handoff prepares the local delivery record for reviewed work. External publication requires separate user authorization.
PR publication binds user approval to an exact GitHub repository, work branch, reviewed delivery commit, and outgoing text.
For a signed delivery, publication can create a regular or draft pull request, update its taskbook summary, or add a discussion comment.
When a committed fact diff exists, publication posts it as a pull request comment and uses deterministic markers to recognize comments already sent.
